stories.headline: The view from Russia: ‘No party can be antiwar’ in parliamentary election
stories.description: First vote since Russia invaded Ukraine seen as a sham by some and an opportunity to strengthen nationalism by others.

stories.headline: Twenty women had breasts removed unnecessarily, NHS trust admits
stories.description: The trust's new chief executive says he apologises unreservedly - "What happened was utterly unacceptable."

stories.headline: ‘My children did not attack Iran’: 2bn South Asians suffer from distant war
stories.description: A quarter of the world’s population faces a surging cost of living crisis because of the wars in the Middle East.
